clue.text: Fool harbouring a black marsupial

indicators.note: harbouring means giving shelter, so the fool holds the other letters inside

parts.note: a wally is British slang for a fool
B is the pencil-grade abbreviation for black

explanation.surface: A dimwit is sheltering some dark-furred pouched animal.
explanation.definitionFit: This hopping Australian animal carries its young in a pouch, like a small kangaroo.

clue.text: Intellectual shows facade, ignoring female with male in charge

indicators.note: ignoring means leaving out, so the female letter is dropped

explanation.surface: A clever person puts on a front, sidelining a woman so a man runs things.
explanation.definitionFit: A scholarly, bookish person is an intellectual.

clue.text: See what mate could finish around new tourist site

parts.note: lo, as in lo and behold, means see

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the game wraps the new letter

parts.note: checkmate ends a game of chess

explanation.surface: Watch what a partner might complete near a fresh visitor attraction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mate' looks like a friend but is checkmate, ending a board game.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scottish lake, famed for its monster legend, draws many visitors.

clue.text: Before joint engagements, one fights in the main

indicators.note: before places the engagements ahead of the joint in the answer

parts.note: military engagements are battles
the hip is a joint

explanation.surface: Before hip operations, a person takes part in mostly combat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is the open sea, and 'in the main' pretends to mean mostly.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavily armed warship fights on the open sea, the main.

clue.text: Sport's just done making first-half appearances

indicators.note: only the opening half of each of the two words shows itself

explanation.surface: A game has only just finished, with players appearing in the first half.
explanation.definitionFit: The Japanese unarmed combat discipline is an Olympic sport.

clue.text: In the military one may advance thus, conforming

definitions.text: In the military one may advance thus
definitions.meaning: soldiers marching in time move forward together
in agreement or harmony with others

explanation.surface: Soldiers march forward in unison, obeying orders.
explanation.definitionFit: Marching in time with others, and so in harmony or agreement.

clue.text: Zealot's found in cooler upstairs room, disheartened

parts.note: a fan cools the air

indicators.note: disheartened means losing the heart, so the middle letter goes

parts.note: an attic is a room at the top of the house

explanation.surface: A fanatical person is discovered, gloomy, in a chilly loft.
explanation.definitionFit: A zealot is an extremist, an obsessive believer.

clue.text: Form group to work as printers

parts.note: a form or kind is a type
a set is a group

explanation.surface: Start a team to work in a print shop.
explanation.definitionFit: Arranging letters for printing is the printers' trade.

clue.text: Problem giving Northern US prosecutor right to probe wharf

indicators.note: something that probes pushes inside, so these letters go into the wharf

parts.note: a quay is a landing wharf
DA, district attorney, is an American prosecutor

explanation.surface: An American prosecutor from up north investigates goings-on at the docks.
explanation.definitionFit: A dilemma or predicament is a problem one cannot easily resolve.

clue.text: Shame about a university campus principally in meagre condition

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the shame word wraps the other letters

parts.note: as in 'what a shame', a pity

indicators.note: principally means chiefly, so only the opening letter of campus is used

explanation.surface: Someone laments a run-down college campus with scant resources.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarcity or insufficiency is the state of having too little, a meagre condition.

clue.text: A few sort out computer programs

indicators.note: sort out suggests rearranging, and out alone here signals the letters being reordered

explanation.surface: An IT worker tidies up a handful of applications.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort out' reads as one phrasal verb, but 'sort' is fodder and 'out' alone is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Programs that run on a computer are collectively the code side, as opposed to hardware.

clue.text: In following heavenly body displaying rings, European's showing gloomy disposition

indicators.note: following places the inner word after the planet

parts.note: Saturn is the ringed planet
E is the abbreviation for European

explanation.surface: A sombre European follows a ringed planet.
explanation.definitionFit: Being glum and morose, a temperament once blamed on a planet's influence.

clue.text: Core military authority announced

indicators.note: announced means spoken out, so the officer's title is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a colonel is a senior army officer, an authority in the military

explanation.surface: The army's central command has made a declaration.
explanation.definitionFit: The innermost, essential part of something, such as a nut's seed, is its core.

clue.text: Record quiet increase in business

parts.note: to record data is to enter it
P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
a rise is an increase

explanation.surface: A firm's books show a quiet upturn in trade.
explanation.definitionFit: A company or commercial venture is a business.

clue.text: Regarding sculpture, for instance, in spare time

parts.note: re means about or regarding
a sculpture is an example of a creation

explanation.surface: Someone makes sculptures as a hobby in their free hours.
explanation.definitionFit: Leisure activity, things done for fun when free from work.

clue.text: Feel the absence of unmarried woman

definitions.meaning: to long for someone who is gone
the title for a woman who has not wed

explanation.surface: Someone pines for a single lady.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is longing for something gone; the other is the title used for a single lady.

clue.text: Drunk riles chap getting round

indicators.note: drunk means unsteady, so these letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A tipsy man annoys another fellow while buying a round of drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting round' suggests buying drinks; 'round' alone is the definition, the shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Shaped like a ball or globe, that is, round.

clue.text: Bounty, great ship heading east

indicators.note: heading means moving towards, so the ship comes before the east letter

parts.note: large means great
SS is steamship

explanation.surface: HMS Bounty, a large vessel, sailing eastwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bounty' pretends to be the famous ship but is generosity.
explanation.definitionFit: Generosity in giving gifts or money is a bounty.

clue.text: Stormy sea for this person is terrifying

indicators.note: stormy means turbulent, so these letters are tossed about

parts.note: the setter refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: Rough waters frighten the speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: Something frightening and alarming is terrifying.

clue.text: A barrier, worker being stubborn

parts.note: a dam is a barrier
a worker ant

explanation.surface: A worker on a dam obstinately refuses to budge.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflexible, refusing to change one's mind, so stubborn.

clue.text: A train's transported powerful Russian

indicators.note: transported means carried away, so these letters are moved around

explanation.surface: A locomotive has carried some mighty Russian figure.
explanation.definitionFit: A Russian empress, wife of the tsar, held great power.

clue.text: A thing placed on course, maybe, as support

parts.note: a wager is placed at a racecourse, so a bet

explanation.surface: Something set on a path as a prop.
explanation.definitionFit: To aid or encourage, usually in wrongdoing, is to support.

clue.text: Devoted follower around home and school

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the follower encloses the home word

parts.note: a disciple is a devoted follower
being at home is being in

explanation.surface: A loyal adherent hangs about the house and the classroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'school' looks like a noun but is a verb: to train.
explanation.definitionFit: To school someone is to train and control them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Upset, French and popular US soldier flare up

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the letters read upward

parts.note: et is French for and
in means popular, fashionable
a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: An angry French person and a well-liked American soldier lose their tempers.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch fire or set alight, to burst into flame.

clue.text: A uniform rule defended by chap? It's a telling sign

parts.note: U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: defended by means protected on both sides, so the chap surrounds the rule letter

parts.note: a guy is a chap

explanation.surface: A man guards a dress code; is that a revealing indication?
explanation.definitionFit: An omen or portent is a sign that tells of what is to come.

clue.text: Steep drain manufactured in West, perhaps

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters inside the first name

parts.note: Mae West was an American film actress, so West is an example of someone called Mae

indicators.note: manufactured means made up, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A sharply sloping drain built out in the west.
explanation.walkthrough: 'West' looks like a compass point, but 'perhaps' marks it as one example of a person called Mae: the 1930s film star Mae West.
explanation.definitionFit: To soak food in a seasoned liquid is to steep it.

clue.text: One with major corporation might follow this parliament

definitions.text: One with major corporation might follow this
definitions.meaning: corporation is jocular for a paunch, so a large-bellied person might follow a slimming regime
a legislative assembly, as in some European countries

explanation.surface: A big company might be guided by this legislature.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is an eating plan to lose a paunch; the other is a legislative assembly.

clue.text: Reportedly, movie star's leading place for a driving break?

indicators.note: reportedly means as spoken, so the phrase is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: Brad Pitt is a film star, and leading means on top, so Pitt's top

explanation.surface: Word is that a film star's principal hangout is a motorway rest stop.
explanation.definitionFit: A racing car halts in the trackside bay for fuel and tyres, a break in driving.

clue.text: Period after which a ton may be delivered

definitions.text: Period after which a ton may be delivered

parts.words: Period after which a ton may be delivered
parts.note: in cricket a ton is a century, a hundred runs, which a batter reaches after the score in the high ...-to-ninety-nine range

explanation.surface: A time after which a heavy load is dispatched.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a ton is a score of a hundred runs; a batter passes through the range of scores just below it first.
explanation.definitionFit: A decade-like span of ages or scores from ninety to ninety-nine is a period.

clue.text: Number, say, occupying place in ground

indicators.note: occupying means filling a space, so the example abbreviation sits within the burial word

parts.note: to inter is to bury
EG, for example, is signalled by say

explanation.surface: Perhaps a figure is lodged somewhere in a sports field.
explanation.definitionFit: A whole number with no fraction is one kind of number.
